queries_run: Silicon Motion Technology distribution channel shift 2026
SIMO Silicon Motion business model transition platform 2026 MonTitan enterprise

findings.claim: 直銷占銷售比重由 2023/2024 的 65% 降至 2025 的 53%，其餘為經銷商，即經銷通路占比上升至約 47%
findings.excerpt: Approximately 65% of our sales in 2023, 65% of our sales in 2024, and 53% of our sales in 2025 were attributable to our direct sales force while the remainder was attributable to distributors.

channel_business_model_shift.note: Computex 2026 報導稱公司高層表示零售 SSD 通路近乎消失、量轉向 PC 品牌／模組廠（二手轉述，見 clues）；MonTitan 企業級轉型見搜尋摘要但未取得可逐字原文。

clues.claim: Computex 2026：公司副總稱零售 SSD 市場上半年近乎消失，量直接流向 PC 品牌與模組廠
clues.source: Geeknetic：Silicon Motion confirma un giro en el mercado SSD
